evidenceContract.userBehavior: Request one named durable Markdown plan from a Workspace conversation with a concise summary and one recommended next action.
canonicalPath: summary, document reference and next-action conversation projection

observables.description: Terminal turn, separated summary and next action, exact Canvas projection, and terminal idle facts.
At least one durable Markdown file exists under the canonical generated file directory.

evidenceContract.expectedResult: The Agent emits ordinary Markdown with one admitted document section; the Host publishes only that section and projects the visible result as concise summary, Markdown file reference, then one state-grounded recommended next action.
evidenceContract.expectedFailure: Whole-response JSON, a visible wire marker or document body in the final chat, a missing or duplicated next action, missing durable Markdown, missing Canvas projection, or a non-idle turn fails.

steps.prompt: Create a named, durable, reviewable Markdown document titled Release Readiness Plan. Its document body must include a Risks section and a Verification section. In the ordinary conversation reply, summarize completion with the exact token ARTIFACT_READY. Recommend exactly one next action with the exact token NEXT_ACTION_READY.
